aiMetadata.description: Submits a new HeyGen avatar-video render from an existing template, filling in the template variables (text, image/video/audio URLs, character, voice). Use to programmatically generate videos at scale from a reusable template; requires a valid template ID and produces a new render each call (not idempotent). Rendering is asynchronous — poll Retrieve Video Status or use the completion trigger for the finished output.

retrieve-translated-video-status.name: retrieve-translated-video-status
retrieve-translated-video-status.description: Retrieves the status of a translated video.

videoId.description: The ID of the translated video to check the status for.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up the current processing status (and result details) of a video-translation job by its translation video ID. Use to poll whether a previously submitted Translate Video job has completed. Read-only and idempotent. Note the ID here is the translate-job ID, distinct from the avatar-video ID used by Retrieve Video Status.

retrieve_video_status.name: retrieve_video_status
retrieve_video_status.description: Retrieve the status and details of a video using its ID.

videoId.description: The ID of the video to retrieve the status for.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up the processing status and details (including the output URL once ready) of an avatar/template-generated video by its video ID. Use to poll whether a generation job has finished before downloading or sharing. Read-only and idempotent. For video-translation jobs use Retrieve Translated Video Status instead.

retrieve_sharable_video_url.name: retrieve_sharable_video_url
retrieve_sharable_video_url.description: Generates a public URL for a video, allowing it to be shared and accessed publicly.

videoId.description: The ID of the video to generate a shareable URL for.

aiMetadata.description: Enables public sharing for a finished video and returns a publicly accessible share URL, given the video ID. Use when an agent needs a link it can hand out without authentication. This is a server-side mutation that toggles the video to shareable, so treat it as not idempotent.

upload_asset.name: upload_asset
upload_asset.description: Upload media files (images, videos, or audio) to HeyGen. Supports JPEG, PNG, MP4, WEBM, and MPEG files.

file.description: The file to upload (JPEG, PNG, MP4, WEBM, or MPEG).

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a media file (image, video, or audio) to HeyGen so it can be referenced in later video/template generation. Use to stage assets before composing a video. Only JPEG, PNG, MP4, WEBM, and MPEG are accepted; content type is inferred from the file extension. Each call creates a new asset, so it is not idempotent.

translate_video.name: translate_video
translate_video.description: Translate a video into 175+ languages with natural voice and lip-sync.

videoUrl.description: URL of the video file to be translated. Supports direct URLs, Google Drive, and YouTube.

title.description: Optional title of the translated video.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key by navigating to your Space Settings in HeyGen App.

outputLanguage.description: Select the language for video translation.

translateAudioOnly.description: Only translate the audio without modifying faces.

speakerNum.description: Number of speakers in the video (if applicable).

auth.description: You can obtain your API key by navigating to your Space Settings in HeyGen App.

brandVoiceId.description: Select the Brand Voice to apply to the video.

callbackId.description: Custom ID returned in webhook callback.

callbackUrl.description: URL to notify when translation is complete.

aiMetadata.description: Submits a video-translation job that dubs a source video into a target language with natural voice and lip-sync, optionally audio-only (no face modification). Use to localize an existing video given its URL (direct, Google Drive, or YouTube) and an output language. Processing is asynchronous and each call starts a new job (not idempotent); poll Retrieve Translated Video Status for the result.

list_avatars.name: list_avatars
list_avatars.description: Retrieve a list of all available avatars.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all avatars available to the account. Use to discover avatar IDs before composing or generating a video. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

list_voices.name: list_voices
list_voices.description: Retrieve a list of all available voices.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all voices available to the account. Use to discover voice IDs before composing or generating a video. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

list_videos.name: list_videos
list_videos.description: Retrieve a list of all generated videos.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to retrieve (max 100).

aiMetadata.description: Lists previously generated videos on the account, optionally capped by a limit (default 20, max 100). Use to enumerate videos and their IDs/statuses for follow-up lookups. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

video_generation_completed.name: video_generation_completed
video_generation_completed.description: Triggers when a video is generated successfully.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an avatar video finishes generating successfully (HeyGen avatar_video.success webhook event), signaling the rendered output is ready with its video ID and download URLs.

video_generation_failed.name: video_generation_failed
video_generation_failed.description: Triggers when a video generation process fails.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an avatar video generation fails (HeyGen avatar_video.fail webhook event), providing the affected video ID and an error message so the failure can be handled.
